title: 第23章 师叔你请神术好像不错嘛第24章 道术升级成道经了
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
“什么？先天三重的气息，不对，还有先天五重！”
四目道长连忙放下手中摄魂铃，浑然不顾身后的僵尸。
快步上前，文才紧随其后。
赶到大堂门口，抬头望去，只见堂内聚集数人。
“发生什么事了？外边怎么这么夸张。”
四目道长见到坐于堂内的林凡与九叔。
才安下心来开口问道。
“你先说说你，怎么会跟文才一起。这什么时辰了。”
九叔没好气的说道。
莫不是这不正经的小师叔，带文才去偷蒙拐骗了。
“师父，镇上的糯米卖完了。”
“我到隔壁镇买糯米时碰到了师叔，这才一起回来的。”
文才看出了九叔的不满，焦急的解释道。
“怎么的，我刚谈完生意。”
“怕我的小师侄一个人回来危险。”
“反正顺路。我这当师叔的还不能保护他一下了。”
四目道长义正言辞的回道。
“行行行。你说什么都是你有理。”
九叔随口答去，没正看四目道长一眼。仿佛与空气作谈一般。
这师弟自己还不了解么，无非就是领着僵尸走一人无趣。

抓着文才当个伴罢了，否则需要这么长时间才回到。
“诶，你这老家伙。你还没说呢，外边怎么回事。”
四目道长见状心中突生一股火。
“呐，没眼看么。”
九叔端起茶水喝了一口，指向了庭内角落的一人一僵。
“哇靠，这黑的跟碳一样。”
“行啊师兄，这一个先天三重，一个先天五重。”
“居然让你师徒几人收拾的服服帖帖。”
四目道长玩味的朝九叔提了提下颚。
嘴角还不忘带有一丝奸笑。
话音一落。
只见九叔提起手向林凡指去。
“老不正经，说就说，别乱指指。想怼我的小师侄干嘛。”
四目道长手掌轻轻一拍。
两臂一张，身体朝林凡身前挡去。
“是林凡收拾的。为人师表，你正经一些。”
九叔轻描淡写的说道。
“啊？你拿我开玩笑呢师兄。我看你才是不正经吧。”
四目道长身形一震，好似要倒向林凡的双腿之上。
这小师侄才什么修为，几斤几两我还不知道？

别说先天五重的高手了。
哪怕就这躺着的紫僵，也能将其挫骨扬灰。
四目道长心里暗道。
content_en:
"What? The aura of the third level of innateness, no, there is also the fifth level of innateness!"
Taoist Priest Four Eyes quickly put down the soul-stirring bell in his hand, completely ignoring the zombies behind him.
He quickly stepped forward, followed closely by Wen Cai.
He rushed to the entrance of the lobby and looked up, only to see several people gathered in the hall.
"What happened? Why is it so exaggerated outside?"
Taoist Priest Simu saw Lin Fan and Uncle Jiu sitting in the hall.
Then he calmed down and asked.
"First tell me why you are with Wen Cai. What time is it?"
Uncle Jiu said angrily.
Could it be that this unscrupulous little uncle took the scholar to secretly abduct him.
"Master, the glutinous rice in town is sold out."
"I met my uncle when I went to the next town to buy glutinous rice, and we came back together."
Wencai saw Uncle Jiu's dissatisfaction and explained anxiously.
"Why, I just finished discussing business."
"I'm afraid it will be dangerous for my little nephew to come back alone."
"Anyway, I'm on my way. As a master uncle, I can't protect him."
The four-eyed Taoist priest replied righteously.
"Okay, okay. Whatever you say is right."
Uncle Jiu answered casually without looking at Taoist Priest Simu. It's like talking to the air.
Don't you know this junior brother himself? It's just boring to lead zombies away alone.
Just keep Wen Cai as a companion, otherwise it would take so long to get back.
"Hey, you old guy. You haven't said anything yet, what's going on outside."
Seeing this, Taoist Priest Four Eyes felt a sudden fire in his heart.
"Hey, can't you see it?"
Uncle Jiu took a sip of tea and pointed at the person standing in the corner of the court.
"Wow, it's as black as carbon."
"Okay, senior brother, this one is at the third level of innateness, and the other is at the fifth level of innateness."
"You actually let your master and disciples take care of themselves."
Taoist Priest Four Eyes raised his chin towards Uncle Jiu in a playful manner.
There was also a hint of a sinister smile on the corner of his mouth.
The words fell.
Uncle Jiu raised his hand and pointed towards Lin Fan.
"I'm not serious. Just say what you say and don't point fingers. Why do you want to criticize my little nephew?"
The four-eyed Taoist priest patted him lightly with his palm.
He opened his arms and moved his body in front of Lin Fan.
"Lin Fan took care of it. As a role model, you should be more serious."
Uncle Jiu said lightly.
"Ah? Are you kidding me, senior brother? I think you are the one who is not serious."
The Taoist priest with four eyes trembled, as if he was about to fall onto Lin Fan's legs.
What kind of cultivation does this little nephew have? I don’t know how much he weighs?
Not to mention the five-level innate master.
Even if Zi Zhan is lying down, he can be crushed to ashes.
Taoist Priest Simu thought to himself.
